verses.38:3: كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنࣲ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصࣲ‏

meaning: The root نوص (nwS) primarily means to move, stir, or prepare for motion. It also signifies turning aside, drawing back, retreating, or fleeing from something or someone.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
